policy.purpose: Pair repeated winning entry families with the best currently observed exit candidates while sidecar keeps testing challengers.
policy.replacement_rule: Use the primary candidate until another candidate has better live net PnL after fees with enough closed samples.
policy.oracle_solution_usage: Main mock executes family-specific oracle-distilled exit solutions derived from hindsight labels; sidecar matrix continues to run every explicit exit variation so changing signals can replace the active oracle solution.
policy.active_execution_source: live_hindsight_missed_winner_audit_rows.csv family quantiles, not per-row future extrema at decision time
policy.sidecar_monitoring: live_family_registry_compare keeps default, runner, scalp, pressure-hold, hard TP/SL, fast-fail, and oracle p25/median/p75 variants running in parallel.
policy.strategy_context_oracle_usage: Guard/stage/bucket misses now use exact strategy-context oracle distributions as active mock routes, with sidecar variants still running.
policy.sidecar_pairing_update_rule: Sidecar candidates populate live evidence and shadow candidate exits. Execution remains controlled by active_candidate_id plus execution_enabled.
